page0.text:
"...Ngh."
I don't know how serious Illya is.
I'm sure telling me to be her Servant is some sort of metaphor, and even if she makes me her familiar, nothing's going to change.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page0:1

page1.text:
I still won't be of any use, and besides, Illya has Berserker.
Illya doesn't have any kind of use for a half-assed mage like me.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page1:1

page2.text:
"Answer me.
Will you be with me?"
Illya's voice practically brims with expectation.
And so I...
"...Fine. I'll be your familiar."
I lie evasively for the time being.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page2:1

page3.text:
"Okay! This is exciting! We'll be together forever, brother!"
"Wha...?"
Illya starts jumping up and down. She must be really excited.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page3:1

page4.text:
"..."
...I feel guilty.
Illya's holding me prisoner, so I had to lie.
But I feel bad seeing her so happy...so maybe I can indulge Illya a little bit...
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page4:1

page5.text:
"Eh...?"
A wave of dizziness crashes over me.
An invisible weight settles across my shoulders.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page5:1

page6.text:
"Illya."
Increasingly uneasy, I find myself calling out to her.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page6:1

page7.text:
"Hm? What is it, Shirou? Oh, I'll undo the restraints on your wrists for you."
"...Ah. That's not what I... I just feel a little sick."
Sudden nausea grips me, and I find myself gasping for breath.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page7:1

page8.text:
"What is it? Do you feel sick? Does your body feel like it's weighing you down? Do you have this indescribable sense of anxiety?"
She smiles.
It's a cruel smile, like she sees right through me.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page8:1

page9.text:
"Illya..."
"Yep. I know everything about you, because you formed a contract with me.
So now you can't hide anything from me."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page9:1

page10.text:
"Gh—!?"
Oh, God...
The strange sense of unease drives me to my feet. It's not at all like the more immediate fear her presence caused in the past.
But my body refuses to move.
This isn't Illya's magical energy affecting me.
My body just...can't move...!?
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page10:1

page11.text:
"Illya...what did you...!?"
"You did this to yourself. You feel sick because you lied to me. You're a nice person, so you just hurt yourself."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page11:1

page12.text:
"But...well, you didn't really put your heart into your last response, so I'll ask again."
"Shirou...you're mine now, right?"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page12:1

page13.text:
...
The weight on my back digs into me, seeming to squirm into my skin.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page13:1

page14.text: "Come on, admit it, Shirou. Your soul is already mine."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page14:1

page15.text:
"Ah...gahhh...!"
I hear myself wheezing.
My mouth opens on its own, forming words in quick, shallow breaths.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page15:1

page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page16:1

page17.text:
"Yes. I, Illyasviel, have accepted you, Shirou Emiya.
Fufufu. Now I have your soul, Shirou."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page17:1

page18.text:
"...Illya..."
I need to get up. I need to tear off these ropes. I need to run as far and as fast as I can.
If she's in the way, I just need to punch her or something to force her aside.
Otherwise, I don't even want to think about what might happen to me.
Yeah. I'm in such a dire situation, yet for some reason...
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page18:1

page19.text:
"I can't move..."
My limbs don't even react, as if to tell me I'm no longer in control of my own body.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page19:1

page20.text:
"Oh don't worry, Shirou. I've just shut off all the commands going to your body for now.
For now, your body's just keeping your soul alive. I'll have a new body to serve as a container for it soon.
Human bodies are so fragile, so I'm going to transfer your consciousness to something else, so it won't matter even if it breaks."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page20:1

page21.text:
"Oh, but it won't matter if I tell you anyway.
Hmmm, I doubt you'd understand even if I did explain it to you. Getting used to it yourself will probably be better than being told.
Sella, Leysritt. I'm going to start the apport now, so bring me some sort of doll for a container."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page21:1

page22.text:
"...! ...!"
I can't even talk anymore.
I'm physically here, but it feels like I'm watching everything that's happening through a screen.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page22:1

page23.text:
"Here you are, milady. So we are to perform an apport, you say?"
"Yes. I really don't want to wear it, but I'm going to put on the Dress of Heaven because I don't even want to chance messing up. Liz, can you prepare it?"
"...It's done. But are you sure, Illya?"
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page23:1

page24.text: "Wh-what did you just say? Is a defective like you trying to give me her opinion? I-I-I'm not in the wrong here! Sh-Shirou said okay, so I can make him my familiar!"
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page24:1

page25.text:
"No, you are not in the wrong, milady.
Leysritt, please watch your mouth. We needn't concern ourselves with a mere human like him. If anything, he should be honored, even grateful to be able to experience such a miracle."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page25:1

page26.text: "...You indulge Illya too much. Do you realize that might not be such a good thing?"
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page26:1

page27.text: "Leysritt! Refrain from calling milady by her name! Miss Illyasviel is the successor of the Einzbern's miracle... She is nothing like such failures as us!"
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page27:1

page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page28:1

page29.text:
...
The calmer of the two women who appear to be maids approaches me.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page29:1

page30.text:
Liz...or the woman called Leysritt says,
"I'm sorry. You can't go back to that vessel anymore."
My vision goes black, like someone's just flipped a switch.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page30:1

page31.text: "Oh yes, milady. It seems someone has entered the forest. What would you like to do? Shall we send out Berserker?"
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page31:1

page32.text:
I only hear voices.
...This is so strange.
My consciousness is not connected to my limbs, and my senses are...disconnected.
If my body and senses have no connection, then how the hell am I hearing voices?
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page32:1

page33.text:
"Of course not. They came all the way over here, so it would be rude of us not to show them our hospitality. You two, as well as Berserker, should hide.
I'm going to show off my Shirou when Rin and Saber arrive. I'll let Berserker do whatever he wants after."
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page33:1

page34.text:
She giggles.
I feel nothing, and yet...I feel like someone's taking my arm.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page34:1

page35.text:
I'm feeling faint.
I don't know what will happen to me next, but it seems my fight has already ended...
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-01:page35:1
